source.label: Morphling.de, Top 8 Decks from: GenCon T1 World Championship 2003

notes.text: Morphling.de prints no archetype names; archetypes are the names on the lhc Deckbox sets.

Finishes: Carl Winter beat David Allen, Richard Mattiuzzo and Steven Stoots (Winter's report); Ryan Austin and Mattiuzzo were the losing semifinalists (Oscar Tan, You CAN Play Type I #99). Seeds are not known. Morphling.de ranks the Top 8 1 to 8.
183 players and eight Swiss rounds per Carl Winter's winner report; later StarCityGames retrospectives say "nearly 200".
Date from the Wizards Gen Con 2003 schedule ("Type 1 Championship ... Saturday 10:00 AM").
Morphling.de names him "Steven Stoots"; StarCityGames and Deckbox call him "Shane Stoots" (TripleS), and Carl Winter's report has Steve "Shane" Stoots.
Copied as Morphling.de printed it (1 Ancestral Recall, 3 Necromancy). The Deckbox copy has 2 Ancestral Recall and 2 Necromancy, which is two of a restricted card.
Morphling.de prints his name as "I@n DeGraff", his handle.
